home.eyebrow: A dating app with profiles worth reading
home.title: Start with something to talk about.
home.intro: On Histae, you first get to read a bio, a few answers and someone’s take on things. If the interest goes both ways, you can message each other. Photos come when you both decide to share them.
home.readingTitle: That one detail you want to ask about.
home.readingText: The book they lend to everyone. Their opinion on rainy Sundays. The project they can’t stop talking about. A profile can give you plenty to start a conversation with, if it has room to do so.
home.readingAfterthought: That’s why bios get some space on Histae. You can take your time reading them.
home.conversationTitle: You’ve chosen each other. Now you can talk.
home.conversationText: Mutual interest opens a conversation for 24 hours. Ask about something in their profile, pick up on an answer or just say hello. Your photos stay hidden until you both agree to share them.
home.pauseText: Messages pause. You each have another 24 hours to decide whether to continue. Two yeses reopen the conversation. A no, or the deadline passing without two yeses, ends the match. You don’t have to explain your choice.
home.profileTitle: Tell them what a photo wouldn’t.
home.profileText: You can write more than three lines. What you’re working on, what you love sharing, what you’re looking for: there’s room to go into a little detail.
home.profilePrompt: A question to get you started: what could you talk about for hours?
home.safetyTitle: You’re allowed to change your mind.
home.safetyText: You can block someone, report an exchange or withdraw location permission in the app. Continuing a conversation never means you have to show your photos.
home.closingText: The iOS and Android app is in preparation. Official download links will be here once it’s published.
